title: With the beta gate off, sign-in records the JoomlArt plan of a member and refuses nobody
steps: S1: With BETA_GATE off and aMember answering an active plan 10, sign in by email code; read the account.first_sign_in signal.
S2: With BETA_GATE off and aMember answering no subscription, then an API error, sign in by email code; read account.beta_admission.
expect: S1: sign-in 200; signal badge "JoomlArt member" with plan id 10.
S2: sign-in 200 both times; badge "gate off", plans empty; lookup unset for no plan, "failed" for the API error.
evidence: Production 15/10 to 19/10/2026: 21 first sign-ins all read "gate off" with no plans; a one-off aMember lookup found 6 active members among them
fence: decide() with the gate off asks the cached membership call for the label only and always answers allow

tests: gate off: a member signing in by email code is let in and labelled with their plans
gate off: no plan, or a membership call that fails, still signs in as "gate off"
